## 2026-11-20 → 2.9.7 (English)

**Single-file distribution:** this release ships `SARibbon.h` and `SARibbon.cpp` as downloadable assets — add both files to your project to use SARibbon without building the library separately.

### New features

- **`SARibbonParamGrid` — a parameter grid for ribbon panels.** Places a group of "label + field" rows inside a panel with aligned label and field columns:
  - three-column model (leading label | field | trailing label): a row may have a field only, a leading label, both labels, or an explicit `LabelSides`; `addSpanRow()` adds a hint row spanning its column block;
  - all rows share one label-column width and one field-column width; the automatic label width is taken from the longest label in the block and clamped to a configurable range, and each block sizes its own label column so a short label is not padded by a long label living in another block; `setLabelSpacing()` sets the gap between label and field;
  - when the rows do not fit the panel row budget, the grid reflows into `ceil(rows / maxRows)` side-by-side blocks; `FlowPolicy` selects balanced spreading (default) or column-first filling; a span row takes part in the same distribution and spans the block it falls into;
  - row height follows the panel row grid (a 2-row grid in a 3-row panel uses the first two rows and leaves the third empty, aligned with the contents of the neighbouring panels); fields are vertically centred and never stretched; outside a panel the grid falls back to natural row heights;
  - follows `SARibbonBar::panelLayoutMode` (via the new `panelLayoutModeChanged` signal), invalidates the panel's sizeHint cache on width changes, and can be attached with `attachToPanel()` or resolved from its parent panel automatically.
- **`SARibbonBar::panelLayoutModeChanged`** — the `panelLayoutMode` property now has a NOTIFY signal carrying `SARibbonPanel::PanelLayoutMode`. Embedded widgets can adjust their `sizeHint()` within the same layout pass; a batch style change (`setRibbonStyle`) emits it once, before the relayout in `endUpdate`.
- **Title-icon click control** — `SARibbonTitleIconWidget::setClickEnabled()` / `isClickEnabled()` disable click handling entirely; `setMenuEnabled()` / `isMenuEnabled()` disable the built-in window control menu. With the built-in menu disabled, a click emits `titleIconClicked(int button, const QPoint& globalPos)` so the application can show its own menu.

### Fixes

- **Context categories and categories created after a style change now inherit the current ribbon style.** The batch setters inside `setRibbonStyle()` only queue a pending change when the value actually changes, so when the bar already held the target style (style set before the category existed, a plugin adding a context category later) new pages kept the default 3-row layout with word-wrapped text — which showed up as wrapped text and a wrong row height in 2-row style. A new `applyRibbonStyleToCategory()` is now used when inserting a category, when a context category is shown, and at the end of `setRibbonStyle()` (which pushes the full style to every category once more).
- **`SARibbonApplicationWidget` no longer pops up at start-up.** A child widget created before its parent window is shown gets shown together with the parent and keeps its pre-show geometry (no longer the 2/3 width and full height set by `setWidthRatio()`). The widget now stays hidden after construction and after `SARibbonMainWindow::setApplicationWidget()` binding, and is only shown when the application button is clicked; the event filter reads the parent's current size and also reacts to `WindowStateChange`, so the panel no longer lags behind when the window is maximized or restored.

### Build, docs and tests

- PyQt5 / PyQt6 / PySide6 bindings cover `SARibbonParamGrid` (sip definitions, `pyproject` header/source lists, PySide6 typesystem and CMake lists).
- `src/SARibbon.h` and `src/SARibbon.cpp` were regenerated with amalgamate, covering the parameter grid, the title-icon click API, `panelLayoutModeChanged` and everything else merged since 2.9.6.
- New bilingual parameter-grid documentation (`docs/zh|en/use-guide/parameter-grid.md`, linked from the mkdocs navigation) and updated title-bar documentation for the click/menu control; `MainWindowExample` gained a parameter-grid demo panel that shows the automatic column splitting on 3-row / 2-row / 1-row styles.
- New tests: `SARibbonParamGridTest` (20 cases covering column widths, alignment, column splitting, overlap, span rows, panel row-mode following and style inheritance) and `SARibbonTitleIconMenuTest`.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/czyt1988/SARibbon/compare/v2.9.6...v2.9.7

## 2026-11-20 → 2.9.7 (中文)

**单文件使用**：本次发布附带 `SARibbon.h` 与 `SARibbon.cpp` 两个下载附件，直接加入工程即可使用 SARibbon，无需单独编译库。

### 新增功能

- **`SARibbonParamGrid` 参数网格控件**：把一组「标签 + 控件」参数行排进丝带面板，标签列与控件列对齐：
  - 三列制（前标签 | 控件 | 后标签）：一行可以只有控件、带前置标签、带双侧标签，或用 `LabelSides` 显式指定标签侧；`addSpanRow()` 增加横跨所在列块的提示行；
  - 所有行共享同一个标签列宽与控件列宽；自动标签列宽取列块内最长标签并限制在可设置的范围内，每个列块各自计算，短标签不会被另一列块的长标签撑宽；`setLabelSpacing()` 调整标签与控件的间距；
  - 行数超出面板行预算时自动横向分列：`ceil(行数 / 面板行数)` 个列块，`FlowPolicy` 可选均衡摊分（默认）或先填满一列；跨列行与普通行一起参与分列，横跨它落入的列块；
  - 行高跟随面板行网格（3 行面板里的 2 行网格占前两行、第三行留空，与相邻面板的内容对齐），控件垂直居中不拉伸；不在面板里时退化为自然行高；
  - 跟随 `SARibbonBar::panelLayoutMode` 自动重排（配合新增的 `panelLayoutModeChanged` 信号），宽度变化时清面板的 sizeHint 缓存；可用 `attachToPanel()` 手动挂接，也可按父控件自动解析所属面板。
- **`SARibbonBar::panelLayoutModeChanged` 通知信号**：`panelLayoutMode` 属性补上 NOTIFY 信号（参数为 `SARibbonPanel::PanelLayoutMode`）。面板行数变化时通知嵌入控件，嵌入控件可在同一次布局中先更新 `sizeHint()`，避免二次重排；批量切换样式（`setRibbonStyle`）时在 `endUpdate` 重排之前只发一次。
- **标题栏图标点击控制**：`SARibbonTitleIconWidget::setClickEnabled()` / `isClickEnabled()` 可完全禁用图标点击，`setMenuEnabled()` / `isMenuEnabled()` 可关闭内置窗口控制菜单；关闭内置菜单后点击图标发射 `titleIconClicked(int button, const QPoint& globalPos)` 信号，由应用接管点击行为（例如弹出自己的菜单）。

### 修复

- **上下文标签与在样式设置之后新建的 category 不继承当前丝带样式**：`setRibbonStyle()` 的批量 setter 只在值变化时才排 pending，若 bar 的值早已等于目标值（样式在 category 创建前设置、插件随后添加上下文标签），新页面会一直沿用默认的 3 行 + 文字换行，2 行样式下表现为文字换行、行高错乱。现在抽出 `applyRibbonStyleToCategory()`，插入分类、上下文分类显示与 `setRibbonStyle()` 末尾统一走它下发，并在 `setRibbonStyle()` 末尾对所有 category 再完整下发一次。
- **`SARibbonApplicationWidget` 在程序启动时自动弹出**：父窗口未显示时创建的子控件会在父窗口显示时被一并显示，且尺寸停留在显示前的旧几何（不再是 `setWidthRatio` 设定的 2/3 宽度、全高）。现在构造与 `SARibbonMainWindow::setApplicationWidget` 绑定后都保持隐藏，仅在点击应用按钮时显示；事件过滤器改为读取父窗口当前尺寸并响应 `WindowStateChange`，最大化/还原时面板尺寸不再滞后。

### 构建、文档与测试

- PyQt5 / PyQt6 / PySide6 三套 Python 绑定补齐 `SARibbonParamGrid`（sip 定义、`pyproject` 头/源列表、PySide6 typesystem 与 CMake 列表）。
- `src/SARibbon.h` 与 `src/SARibbon.cpp` 已用 amalgamate 重新生成，含参数网格、标题图标点击配置 API、`panelLayoutModeChanged` 等 2.9.6 之后的全部改动。
- 新增参数网格中英文文档（`docs/zh|en/use-guide/parameter-grid.md`，已挂到 mkdocs 导航）与标题栏点击/菜单控制说明；`MainWindowExample` 增加参数网格演示面板，切换 3 行 / 2 行 / 1 行样式可见自动分列。
- 新增测试：`SARibbonParamGridTest`（18 项，覆盖列宽、对齐、分列、重叠、跨列行、面板行模式跟随与样式继承）与 `SARibbonTitleIconMenuTest`。

**完整变更：** https://github.com/czyt1988/SARibbon/compare/v2.9.6...v2.9.7
